issues.on_page: Street Fund Local Receipts: Other 103,880.00 (= Street Fund Capital Improvements 103,880.00, p3)
issues.issue: An unexplained Street Fund receipt (44% of governmental receipts) that exactly matches the year's street capital improvements may be a grant, reimbursement or loan proceeds. That question needs a person, but decision_needed[] is missing from the extraction.

The capital outlay label has no ': <function>' suffix because the statement line mixes General and Street funds. The General Fund detail piece (detail[3], 597.30) is also plain 'Capital Outlay'. The convention calls for 'Capital Outlay: <function>'.
